title: Linguistics
text:
1. Linguistics

Linguistics is the scientific study of languages. This includes phonetics (how sounds are biologically produced), phonology (what sounds languages use and what they do if anything), morphology (how languages organize meanings within words), syntax (how languages arrange words), pragmatics (nonverbal cues given through context), sociolinguistics (using sociology to analyze linguistics), historical linguistics (how languages evolve and where they come from), computational linguistics (how computers understand languages, relevant with NLP nowadays), mathematical linguistics (using math to do linguistics-related things), and more.
